summary: M3 (Attendance Calendar, day-edit, calendar corrections, payroll opening balance + entry overrides, enriched PDF payslip, 6 reports, Audit logs) tested end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases passing. Frontend smoke: admin & owner login land on Dashboard (no redirect loop — iter 4 regression fixed). Owner Settings screen exposes Reports and Audit Logs entries. Reports screen renders with all 6 report kinds and Generate PDF button. Audit Logs screen renders recent events showing actor/role/entity_type as required. Attendance tab → tap employee row → calendar-screen with month grid, legend, and status dots. Tap day → day-detail-sheet appears with Check-In/Check-Out time fields, status chips (PRESENT/HALF DAY/ABSENT/LEAVE) and Save/Close. Employee-login flow exposes emp-code-input/emp-pin-input/login-submit. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).
action_items: No fixes required. All M3 acceptance criteria (attendance calendar, day-edit, calendar corrections with desired times, payroll opening balance + per-entry override + payment_mode + note, enriched PDF payslip with EARNINGS/DEDUCTIONS/Payment mode, 6 report kinds with proper 400 validation, audit logs owner-only) work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1687 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, attendance, payroll, reports, audit) for maintainability; not blocking.

log_audit is only invoked for attendance.edit, correction.approved/rejected, payroll.entry.update. Consider also logging payroll mark-paid, payroll save/lock/unlock, user create/update/delete for complete audit trail (review req mentions 'mark paid' should surface in audit).
PDF payslip test uses pypdf to extract text (reportlab compresses streams — raw byte grep won't work). Test file now uses pypdf; may need adding to backend requirements if used elsewhere.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, dashboard, settings→reports, settings→audit, attendance→calendar→day-sheet, employee login form)

seed_data_creation: Feb-2026 test data created during tests: attendance edit on 2026-02-15 for RMJ001, calendar correction on 2026-02-20 (approved), prior-month ledger advance 2026-01-15 for RMJ003, in-month ledger advance 2026-02-10, payroll save & entry override for 2026-02.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no unresolved issues. Initial test failure on `EARNINGS`/`DEDUCTIONS`/`Payment mode` bytes-in-PDF check was due to reportlab compressing content streams (FlateDecode/ASCII85). Resolved by extracting text with pypdf; strings are correctly present in the rendered PDF.
